headline: Leipzig's heavy week meets a promoted side above them
summary: Leipzig have lost 1-6 at Bayern Munich and 1-4 at Real Madrid inside five days, and kicker reports that coach Martin Demichelis needs wins now, starting with this one. The visitors are the surprise of the season so far: promoted Elversberg sit above Leipzig with 10 points, and they beat Augsburg 4-3 last weekend. Freshness is theirs too — 7 days to prepare against Leipzig's midweek trip. Across 6 bookmakers, with the margin removed, Leipzig are still 68.6% favourites, rated about 1.5 goals the better side, and a 3.75 goal line points to an open afternoon rather than a controlled home win.
read: Leipzig host Elversberg on the back of a 1-6 defeat at Bayern and a 1-4 loss in Madrid, with coach Martin Demichelis reported to need wins now to steady his position. The market still makes Leipzig 68.6% favourites against 13.3% for a promoted Elversberg side sitting above them in the table, and with a 3.75 goal line it expects an open, high-scoring game.

facts.fact: Leipzig were beaten 1-6 at Bayern Munich on Saturday, their third Bundesliga defeat of the season.
facts.meaning: They come into this home game off a rout, with two wins in their last five in all competitions.

facts.fact: Leipzig lost 1-4 at Real Madrid in the Champions League on Wednesday, three days before this match.
facts.meaning: A second heavy defeat in five days, and a midweek trip to Madrid in the legs.

facts.fact: Leipzig are 68.6% to win, with the draw at 18.0% and Elversberg at 13.3%.
facts.meaning: The market makes Leipzig about five times more likely to win than the promoted side, despite those two scorelines.

facts.fact: Kicker reports that Leipzig coach Martin Demichelis needs wins against Elversberg, Schalke and Rot-Weiss Essen to quieten growing doubts about him.
facts.meaning: This is the first of the three matches the report frames as decisive for the coach.

facts.fact: Elversberg are sixth in the Bundesliga with 10 points from six games, above Leipzig in the table.
facts.meaning: The promoted side arrive above their hosts and with nothing to protect.

facts.fact: Elversberg beat Augsburg 4-3 on Saturday, their third win in six Bundesliga games.
facts.meaning: They score freely and concede freely — a wide-open game suits them more than a controlled one.

facts.fact: Francis Onyeka was reported out for up to four weeks with a foot ligament injury two days ago, and reported back in Elversberg team training today.
facts.meaning: Whether he features is genuinely unclear, and Elversberg's squad news has been described as a growing concern.

facts.fact: Elversberg have had seven days since their last match; Leipzig played in Madrid on Wednesday.

sources.fact: German football outlet kicker reports that RB Leipzig coach Martin Demichelis needs wins against Elversberg, Schalke and Rot-Weiss Essen to counter growing doubts about his suitability, and could be under real pressure if that does not happen.
RB Leipzig suffered their third defeat of the season last matchday, losing to Bayern Munich, according to WELT.
Bayern Munich routed Leipzig in the Bundesliga, with Maksimovic scoring Leipzig's consolation goal in stoppage time, reports sportschau.de.
The Guardian describes Bayern's win over Leipzig as a furious rout.
Leipzig play Real Madrid in the Champions League on Wednesday before facing Elversberg in the Bundesliga on Saturday, per sportschau.de.
Elversberg beat Augsburg 4-3 to return to winning ways, their third win in six Bundesliga games, taking them to 10 points and sixth place, according to BILD.
Francis Onyeka has returned to Elversberg team training after a foot ligament injury ahead of the Leipzig match, reports africasoccer.com.
Elversberg could be without Francis Onyeka for up to four weeks after he suffered a foot ligament injury on international duty, according to africasoccer.com.
